(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');for(const t of ['0 issues','0.255','0.127','No pipe design limit'])if(!r.textContent.includes(t))throw Error('Missing pipe result '+t);if(r.querySelector('[data-pipe-count]').dataset.pipeCount!=='2')throw Error('Pipe preview missing');const table=[...r.querySelectorAll('table')].find(t=>t.caption.textContent.startsWith('Airflow'));if(table.tBodies[0].rows.length)throw Error('Pipe in airflow table');r.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});})()

(async()=>{const files=await Promise.all(window.__hvacDownloads);window.__pipeFiles=files;const csv=atob(files[1].base64),j=JSON.parse(atob(files[2].base64));if(j.content.schedules.pipeFlow.length!==2||j.content.schedules.airflow.length||!csv.includes('Inside diameter m'))throw Error('Incorrect actual exports');if(j.content.schedules.commissioning[0].designLs!==2)throw Error('Legacy airflow reused');return {exports:files.map(x=>({type:x.type,bytes:atob(x.base64).length})),pipes:j.content.schedules.pipeFlow};})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');if(!r.textContent.includes('service'))throw Error('Cross-service connection silently accepted');const n=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('[aria-label="Network JSON"]').value);if(n.edges[0].airflowLs!==null||n.edges[0].pipeFlowLs!==null||n.edges[0].innerDiameterM!==null)throw Error('Service change retained flow operands');r.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');const t=[...r.querySelectorAll('table')].find(t=>t.caption.textContent.startsWith('Pipe flow'));if(t.tBodies[0].rows[0].cells[3].textContent!=='unknown')throw Error('Missing bore/flow fabricated velocity');t.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth+1)throw Error('Overflow');})()

(()=>{const n=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('[aria-label="Network JSON"]').value);if(n.edges[0].innerDiameterM!==null||n.edges[1].pipeFlowLs!==1||n.nodes[0].kind!=='pump')throw Error('Pipe reload mismatch');const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');if(r.querySelector('[data-pipe-count]').dataset.pipeCount!=='2')throw Error('Pipe reload preview missing');r.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');const areas=[...r.querySelectorAll('[role="region"]')];if(areas.length!==3)throw Error('Missing focusable schedule regions');for(const a of areas){const t=a.querySelector('table');if(a.tabIndex!==0||t.getBoundingClientRect().width<680||getComputedStyle(t.querySelector('td')??t.querySelector('th')).whiteSpace!=='nowrap')throw Error('Table spacing/focus contract failed');}const p=r.querySelector('[aria-label="Pipe flow schedule, scroll horizontally"]');p.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});p.focus();p.scrollLeft=0;if(p.scrollWidth<=p.clientWidth)throw Error('Expected local tablet scroller');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth+1)throw Error('Page overflow');return {tableWidth:p.scrollWidth,visibleWidth:p.clientWidth,focused:document.activeElement===p};})()

(()=>{const p=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Pipe flow schedule, scroll horizontally"]');p.scrollLeft=p.scrollWidth;if(p.scrollLeft<=0)throw Error('Schedule cannot scroll');return {scrollLeft:p.scrollLeft};})()
